quarterly_data.quarter: Schneider Electric press release: Schneider Electric launches new Motivair coolant (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Schneider Electric launched the WCDU coolant distribution unit in its Motivair by Schneider Electric liquid cooling line. It integrates with fan wall air-cooling systems to support hybrid air and liquid cooling in high-density AI data centers, is optimized for deployment in the technical corridor outside the white space (top entry connections, zero lateral clearance) and puts integrated pumps, heat exchangers and critical components in a single steel frame. A single WCDU achieves cooling capacity up to 3.5 MW at 1.5 liters per minute per kW; up to 20 units can operate together in group mode, which the company says supports today's 30-40 MW data halls. The WCDU will begin shipping in select regions in October 2026; pre-orders open in the U.S. in early 2027. No customers or prices stated.
quarterly_data.figure: Up to 3.5 MW per unit at 1.5 liters per minute per kW; up to 20 units in group mode; shipping in select regions October 2026; U.S. pre-orders early 2027
